text:
Jordan Hsieh: Heads-up everyone — we're deprecating our org-wide Jenkins masters and moving CI to Buildkite (primary) + GitHub Actions for small repos. Timeline: migration kickoff Mon Apr 5, opt-out cutoff May 3, final shutdown Jun 1. See migration doc: https://internal.redwood/migrations/jenkins-to-buildkite-2026. Please read if you own any pipelines.

Priya Nair: Will the existing Jenkins agents be reused or replaced? Any required changes to Docker images?

Jordan Hsieh: Short answer: agents will be repurposed where compatible, but we expect most teams to switch to the new runner image (redwood/ci-runner:stable). We'll publish a compatibility matrix. If your builds need privileged mounts, flag them ASAP — those will require infra review.

Tomasz Zielinski: Dev-ops note: we need to rotate the Jenkins service user tokens and replace webhook secrets. Ops will run a secrets migration job that copies allowed secrets from Jenkins to Vault and creates Buildkite pipeline env vars. Rough command we plan to run in the migration job:
```
# export allowed secrets to vault
./tools/migrate-secrets.sh --from jenkins --to vault --org $ORG --allow-list secrets/ci/*
# create bk pipeline vars
./tools/create-bk-vars.sh --org $ORG --pipeline $PIPELINE
```
Expect a short window where builds referencing old env var names will fail — we'll create compatibility aliases for 2 weeks.

ops-bot: migration job scheduled: migrations/jenkins-secrets-1801234567. Preflight checks: jenkins-master-health -> PASS, webhook-delivery -> PASS, vault-conn -> PASS.

Emma Li: DevEx question: will we provide Jenkinsfile -> Buildkite pipeline converters? Some teams have complex scripted pipelines.

Jordan Hsieh: We're shipping a conversion helper (alpha) that extracts stages and common shell steps and emits a Buildkite pipeline skeleton. It won't cover scripted groovy logic. Conversion instructions + example pipeline in the runbook. Small repos (<10 steps) can stay on GitHub Actions if the owner opts in; we'll add a label to mark that.

Priya Nair: What's the plan for GitHub app permissions? We use the redwood-ci-app currently with write:checks and admin:repo_hook. Need to lock scopes down.

Tomasz Zielinski: We'll replace the Jenkins GitHub app with a new 'redwood-ci-integration' app scoped to read:org, checks:write, actions:read. We'll do an org-level install migration; owners will receive an email to approve the new app. For repos that can't accept the new scopes, we can do a delegated pipeline via a service account.

Jordan Hsieh: CI runners: to join Buildkite pools add the tag 'pool:small' or 'pool:large'. Example runner registration snippet:
```
buildkite-agent start --token $BK_TOKEN --tags "org:$ORG,pool:small" &
```
Make sure your runner auto-updates to redwood/ci-runner:stable.

ops-bot: Reminder: rolling restart will happen for jenkins-database on Jun 1 04:00 UTC. Backups are scheduled.

Emma Li: Support & docs — I'll draft customer-facing status notes and an internal FAQ for SRE/support. Also adding a troubleshooting section for flaky webhook deliveries.

Priya Nair: Any impact to PR checks history or artifacts? We rely on Jenkins artifact store for retention rules.

Tomasz Zielinski: Artifacts will be migrated for the last 90 days into our S3 bucket under ci-artifacts/jenkins-archive/$ORG/. Older artifacts will be archived behind Glacier. Buildkite will use the same bucket path convention. We'll publish retention policy updates.

Jordan Hsieh: Migration cutover groups: week1 alpha (infra-owned repos), week2 beta (platform teams), week3 general availability. If you want to opt-out of week1/2, please fill the opt-out form in the doc by EOD Fri. We'll run smoke jobs post-cutover; rollback procedure is to re-enable the jenkins-proxy and reroute webhooks — steps are documented.

Emma Li: I'll also coordinate a couple office-hours sessions to help teams convert pipelines (dates in the doc).

Jordan Hsieh: Thanks — please add any blockers below. If you maintain any fragile scripted groovy logic, ping @Tomasz for a pairing slot. :rocket:
